scripts.build:native: SDK_PATH=$(cd resources/sdk && pwd) && clang++ -shared -fPIC -O2 -fobjc-arc -F "$SDK_PATH" -framework SketchUpAPI -framework Foundation -I "$SDK_PATH/SketchUpAPI.framework/Headers" -Wl,-rpath,"$SDK_PATH" -Wl,-headerpad_max_install_names -o resources/native/libskpviewer.dylib resources/native/skp-bridge.mm
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && electrobun build && electrobun dev
scripts.install:app: bun run build:native && electrobun build --env=stable && cp -r "build/stable-macos-arm64/SKP Viewer.app" /Applications/
